lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the branchial region, comprising approximately five horizontal rows with varying inter-node spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of spots to form a lattice-like visual structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature on the upper third of the flank characterized by a high-contrast luminance transition, appearing light on the superior edge and shadowed on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, elongated white linear feature is visible trailing the posterior-ventral margin of the left pectoral fin, indicative of a biological attachment or tag.
